scope: prove whether 0x77C343 really clears the local phase

evidence.breakpoint_installed: 0x77C343 first byte reads cc in the live process
evidence.phase_reached: the forward injection log records state 3 (challengeResponse), state 4 (connectResponse), state 4 (statsResponse) and state 7 (1172-byte 1F/21 gamestate fragments), so the client did reach 7

slot_array_probe.observed: slot 0 phase 0; slot 1 value 0x8120C2B0-like pointer; slot 2 another pointer; slots 3..11 zero
slot_array_probe.interpretation: 0x76446B0 is the base of a per-client record array, but only slot 0 is the local client phase; the other slots are not phase values

conclusion: 0x77C343 is NOT the store that clears the local phase. The breakpoint was installed and never hit, yet the phase fell from 7 to 0. The phase-clearing write must come from an indirect store, a bulk clear, or another path that the immediate-store scan does not cover.

or place a one-shot breakpoint on the 0x77C290 entry (--breakpoint 0x77c290:teardown_enter) to learn whether the teardown routine runs at all
